mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_AI_USAGE (DAY, FEATURE, CALLS, FAILS, IN_TOKENS, OUT_TOKENS, CACHE_READ, CACHE_WRITE, COST_USD) VALUES ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::DATE, #{feature}, #{calls}, #{fails}, #{inTokens}, #{outTokens}, #{cacheRead}, #{cacheWrite}, #{cost}) ON CONFLICT (DAY, FEATURE) DO UPDATE SET CALLS = T_AI_USAGE.CALLS + EXCLUDED.CALLS ,FAILS = T_AI_USAGE.FAILS + EXCLUDED.FAILS ,IN_TOKENS = T_AI_USAGE.IN_TOKENS + EXCLUDED.IN_TOKENS ,OUT_TOKENS = T_AI_USAGE.OUT_TOKENS + EXCLUDED.OUT_TOKENS ,CACHE_READ = T_AI_USAGE.CACHE_READ + EXCLUDED.CACHE_READ ,CACHE_WRITE = T_AI_USAGE.CACHE_WRITE + EXCLUDED.CACHE_WRITE ,COST_USD = T_AI_USAGE.COST_USD + EXCLUDED.COST_USD ,UPD_DAY = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COST_USD), 0)::FLOAT8 FROM T_AI_USAGE WHERE DAY = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::DATE
SELECT DAILY_USD::FLOAT8 AS "dailyUsd" ,PAUSED_YN = 'Y' AS "paused" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM UPD_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "updAt" FROM T_AI_BUDGET WHERE ID = 1

SELECT TO_CHAR(DAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day" ,SUM(CALLS)::INT AS "calls" ,SUM(FAILS)::INT AS "fails" ,SUM(COST_USD)::FLOAT8 AS "cost" FROM T_AI_USAGE WHERE DAY > (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::DATE - #{days} GROUP BY DAY ORDER BY DAY

SELECT FEATURE AS "feature" ,CALLS AS "calls" ,FAILS AS "fails" ,IN_TOKENS AS "inTokens" ,OUT_TOKENS AS "outTokens" ,CACHE_READ AS "cacheRead" ,COST_USD::FLOAT8 AS "cost" FROM T_AI_USAGE WHERE DAY = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::DATE ORDER BY COST_USD DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CALLS), 0)::INT AS "calls" ,COALESCE(SUM(COST_USD), 0)::FLOAT8 AS "cost" FROM T_AI_USAGE WHERE DAY >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::DATE
